PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-API_CONFIG.title: API Configuration
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-USERNAME.title: Username
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-A_P_I_KEY.title: API Key
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-A_P_I_KEY.hover.desc: A PiShock [gold]API Key[/gold]. You can generate one in the PiShock website, in your Account settings.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-SHOCKER_I_D.title: Shocker ID
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-SHOCKER_I_D.hover.desc: The Shocker ID that you want this mod to trigger. You can find it in your Shocker settings. This is NOT a Hub ID.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-ADDITIONAL_SHOCKER_I_D_: [gold](Optional)[/gold] Additional Shocker ID to trigger while taking damage. You can find it in your Shocker settings. This is NOT a Hub ID.

PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-SHOCKER_CONFIG.title: Shocker(s) Settings
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MAX_INTENSITY.title: Maximum Intensity:
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MAX_INTENSITY.hover.des: The [gold]intensity[/gold] of the vibrations and shocks will never surpass this range.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MIN_INTENSITY.title: Minimum Intensity:
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MIN_INTENSITY.hover.des: The [gold]intensity[/gold] of the vibrations and shocks will never be less than this range.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MAX_DURATION.title: Maximum Duration:
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MAX_DURATION.hover.desc: The [gold]lenght[/gold] of the beeps, vibrations and shocks will never surpass this range.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MIN_DURATION.title: Minimum Duration:
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-MIN_DURATION.hover.desc: The [gold]lenght[/gold] of the beeps, vibrations and shocks will never be less than this range.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-ALWAYS_MAX_POWER.title: Always shock at Maximum power
Shocks will always trigger at your chosen [gold]Maximum Intensity[/gold] and [gold]Maximum Duration[/gold] instead of escalate based on damage taken.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-GAMEPLAY.title: Gameplay Settings
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-FAULTY_INSULATION.title: Faulty Insulation
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-FAULTY_INSULATION.hover: [gold]Insulation[/gold] will not prevent the trigger of shocks after taking damage.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-DEATH_PENALTY.title: Death Penalty
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-DEATH_PENALTY.hover.des:
Defeat will [gold]ALWAYS[/gold] trigger a shock at max power.
(Being [gold]Insulated[/gold] or disabling/losing your relic will NOT avoid this penalty).
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-HEALING_VIBRATES.title: Positive Feedback
Your Shocker will [gold]vibrate[/gold] when you rest in a campfire or beat the game.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-TRIGGER_SELF_DAMAGE.hov: During combat, your Shocker will also trigger at the end of your turn if you took damage during it.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-ALLOW_PUNISHMENTS.title: Enable Punishment Cards
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-ALLOW_PUNISHMENTS.hover: Allow multiplayer cards used by other players trigger your Shocker.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-DEBUG.title: Debug/Sync
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-VIBRATE_ONLY.title: Vibrate Only
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-VIBRATE_ONLY.hover.desc: Replace all the shock calls for vibration calls.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-VERBOSE_LOGS.title: Detailed Logs
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-VERBOSE_LOGS.hover.desc: Grants additional information in the BaseLib terminal.
PISHOCKTHESPIRE2-SEND_VIBRATION_TEST.hov: Makes the target Shockers [gold]vibrate[/gold] at max power.
